title: NoticeSubject
description: What a `session.notice` is about, normalised by the adapter of the engine so that a client reads it the same whatever engine made it. Every field is optional, and a `kind` sets the ones it has: the command of a `command.output`, the hook of a `hook.failed`.

command.description: The slash command a `command.output` answers, as typed — `/cost`.

hook.description: The name of the automation a `hook.failed` names.

trigger.description: What ran the hook — `beforeTool`, `afterTool`, and whatever the engine's own events name.
